main_text.p: gloriosissimorum Apostolorum Christi malignan-tium Synodo congregata ad ipsam Hierarchām Ignatium conduci procuravit, adductisq; septuaginta duobus hominibus gregariis, qui falsum testimonium dicerent, persuadet illis, cum essent laici, partim minis, partim promissis inuertens, & ad suam sententiam transferens, affirmata teste divina omni potestate, iurandum interponere, ante annos undecim, menses quatuor, & dies viginti non fuisse promotum rite in Sedem Patriarchām, lecto in Congregatione segmento apostaticæ decisionis in hunc modum. Si quis Episcopus Laicorum Principum ope in possessionem Ecclesiæ venerit deponatur; id quod sequitur Canonis, premens, & per sola afferta depositionem decernens. Id ubi addidicit Sanctus Papa Nicolaus, neque enim latere poterat per universum terrarum Orbem dispersa consimilis iniquitas, proprios locumtenentes accurate examinatos, & propriis eorundem sermonibus muneribus corruptos esse comprehensos perpetua depositione punit, & divina sacraq; Synodo coacta, Photium uti adulterum & assultorem anathematizat: quæ illius gratia, & ab ipso, nullo modo admittenda esse decernens, & cum eo communicantibus Michaeli Imperatori, Photio, subditis, Principibus, & reliquis Sanctis Patriarchis Synodicis suis dimissis. page.notes: No margin notes and no footnotes are printed on this page. The left and right edges show stains and show-through from the reverse, which are not transcribed. The word Patriarchām carries a macron over the a in the scan; I transcribed it as printed but the mark is faint. Hierarchām has the same faint macron. The spelling iurandum is kept as printed, the u after i not changed to v.
